37:52.text: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

37:53.text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

37:55.text: And he will look and see him
in the midst of the Hellfire.

37:56.text: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

37:57.text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in

37:58.text: Then, are we not to die

37:59.text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

37:60.text: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

37:61.text: For the like of this let the workers

37:62.text: a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

37:63.text: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

37:64.text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

37:65.text: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

37:66.text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

37:67.text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

37:68.text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

37:69.text: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

37:71.text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

37:72.text: And We had already sent among them warners.

37:73.text: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

37:74.text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

37:75.text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and

37:76.text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
